talents.name: Decapitate
talents.description_html:
Attempt to decapitate an injured enemy, dealing 220% Weapon Damage plus 27. After paying its base cost, Decapitate consumes half of your remaining Energy, up to 55 additional Energy. Against monsters, each additional Energy spent increases its damage by 1%.

Only usable on enemies below 35% health.
